Please read and accept these conditions before using motorcycle write features.
Unofficial community app. Not affiliated with or endorsed by Triumph Motorcycles.
The app is provided without warranty. Stop if the motorcycle, adapter, or response is not exactly as expected.
Resetting a service reminder does not perform maintenance.
Clearing a trouble code erases diagnostic evidence; it does not repair the fault.
Use the app only on a motorcycle you own or are authorized to service. You are responsible for checking the result.
This project supports owner-performed and independent maintenance. It does not modify ECU maps, calibration, emissions, or immobilizer settings.
I understand and accept these conditions.
Pair or select an adapter before connecting.
Choose a bonded vLinker adapter, or pair it in Android Bluetooth settings.
Checking that the adapter identity matches the selected map.
Allow the Bluetooth permission requested by Reset Moto Reminders, then try again.
Pair vLinker MC-Android in Android Bluetooth settings using PIN 1234, then return and select it.
The adapter did not respond in time. Check that it is powered and nearby, then try again.
The connected device does not match the selected adapter map. Disconnect and select the correct adapter.
The adapter closed the connection. Check power and Bluetooth range before reconnecting.
Bluetooth communication failed. Check adapter power and range, then try again.
Unavailable until the motorcycle profile is validated.
Reads known non-sensitive ECU identifiers and DTC information once. It never clears faults or changes the service reminder.
Keep the ignition on and engine off. Do not leave the app until the capture finishes.
Reported DTC count: %1$d. %2$d responses were logged. Disconnect and return with the phone logs.
%1$s Disconnect and return with the phone logs.
Read-only capture stopped after a connection or adapter error.
ECU rejected the observed extended diagnostic session; security access was not attempted
DTC count remained unavailable in the observed extended session; security access was not attempted
Reads confirmed diagnostic trouble codes from the engine ECU. This does not clear or change anything.
Reading confirmed trouble codes. Keep the ignition on.
No confirmed trouble codes are stored.
Reading trouble codes stopped after a connection or adapter error.
The ECU reported %1$s codes but returned %2$s. Try reading again.
The module did not respond. Check that the ignition is on, then try again.
Reads the odometer directly from the motorcycle dashboard. This is read-only and never changes the service reminder.
Reading the motorcycle dashboard. Keep the ignition on.
Reading the dashboard stopped after a connection or adapter error.
The instrument returned an unrecognized response; nothing was written.
Runs security access and clears confirmed engine codes. Only clear codes you have already read and understood.
Clearing trouble codes. Keep the ignition on and do not leave the app.
Cleared. No confirmed trouble codes remain.
Clear completed, but %1$d code(s) are still present.
This sends a write to the engine ECU. Confirm to proceed.
Clearing trouble codes stopped after a connection or adapter error.
The ECU refused the extended diagnostic session; nothing was cleared.
The ECU did not return a usable security seed; nothing was cleared.
The ECU rejected security access; nothing was cleared.
The ECU rejected the clear request; no codes were cleared.
The clear completed but the code count could not be confirmed.
The clear attempt began, but no reliable result was received. Codes may already be cleared. Reconnect and read trouble codes before retrying.
The ECU accepted the clear, but the follow-up code count was lost. Reconnect and read trouble codes.
Writes a new service interval and next-service date to the instrument cluster. Resetting a reminder does not perform maintenance.
Writing the service reminder. Keep the ignition on and do not leave the app.
Before resetting, make sure the motorcycle’s date and time are correct.
Unit currently selected on the motorcycle
Use a multiple of %1$d %2$s, between %3$d and %4$d %2$s.
This writes to the instrument cluster: interval %1$d %2$s, next service %3$s. Confirm to proceed.
Resetting the service reminder stopped after a connection or adapter error.
The requested interval or date is outside the supported range; nothing was written.
The instrument returned an unrecognized status; nothing was written.
The cluster rejected the service-interval write, so the reset stopped before changing the date.
The cluster did not confirm the service-date write.
The service interval was accepted, but the date was not confirmed. Check the motorcycle before retrying.
A reminder write was attempted, but no reliable result was received. The interval or date may have changed. Check the motorcycle before retrying.
Connected motorcycle profile does not match the validated cluster.
Instrument status (%1$s) does not match the validated cluster (%2$s).
Connected cluster matches the validated fingerprint.
For vLinker MC-Android, pair in Android settings with PIN 1234. OBDLink CX pairs when connected.
